column1: # Wave 2c's names (docs/port/PCONLY.md 3 and 4): the names wave 2b's area agents found wrong, the last address names
# of src/, include/ and port/ (and the tools' lists that name them: port/data/decoupled.txt, asm_functions.txt), and
# the files named after an address or after something they don't hold. Evidence: the MAT3 decomp (symbols.txt, its
# C) and the code. The copies of a global under an address-suffixed name (TB_FlashTextColors_AEAC, Hidden_9F54,
# getB6_*, item_refresh_*, pak_slot_b* ...) went by hand before this map (their callers call the global), and so did
# image A's calls of six functions by the runtime images' stale labels (player_mode_set, sound_handles_array_clear,
# audio_dma_sync, audio_bus_mix, audio_interrupt_handler, particle_lifetime_set): their rows below rename what is left
# of them, the runtime images' table keys. The boot tail's hand-written GSM routines (func_80027980 ...) were named by
# hand too, in port/data/asm_functions.txt and asm/us/boot_data/kernels.s, the only places they are named.
